title: V2: Caddy has an RFC 7230 §6.1 compliance issue / Hop-by-hop headers that leak through (CVE-2026-55458)
description: Caddy v2 prior to 2.11.5 has a vulnerability where hop-by-hop headers defined in RFC 7230 §6.1 are not stripped from upstream responses during WebSocket protocol upgrades (HTTP 101 Switching Protocols). This allows headers such as Alt-Svc, Keep-Alive, Proxy-Authenticate, and Set-Cookie to leak through to clients, potentially enabling connection hijacking, cookie injection, and proxy authentication phishing. The issue arises because the code path handling 101 responses returns early and bypasses the header stripping logic that is correctly applied to normal HTTP responses.
